change.summary: Webhook delivery retries now wait 1s, 2s, 4s up to 60s with jitter, instead of retrying every second.

rationale.why: Fixed one-second retries hammered a recovering receiver and tripped its rate limit, which extended the outage.

intent.quote: stop us from making their outage worse

alternatives.choice: Keep fixed retries and cap attempts at 5
alternatives.tradeoff: Simpler, but drops deliveries during any outage longer than five seconds.

alternatives.choice: Queue failed deliveries for manual replay
alternatives.tradeoff: No load on the receiver, but needs a person for every outage.

evidence.summary: Replayed last week's receiver outage: peak request rate fell from 60/min to 9/min.

limits.statement: Not exercised against a receiver that returns Retry-After headers.
Receivers tolerate up to 60 seconds of delivery delay.

approval.note: Ship it; follow up on Retry-After.
